Let’s talk about Chapter 15—Living with Intention.
At the heart of everything is intention. It’s that quiet force guiding the way we move through our days—even if we don’t always realize it.
Most folks? They’re on autopilot. Habits run the show, routines steer the ship. But when you choose to live with intention, you bring a whole different energy to even the smallest moments.
Picture this: you start your morning with just one question— What do I want to notice today? Maybe it’s something simple—a splash of morning sunlight, a genuine smile from someone you care about, or just a quiet moment of gratitude.
When you set an intention like that, your day doesn’t just happen to you. You’re primed to notice things. You appreciate more, you engage more deeply. It’s like tuning your mind to a richer frequency.
The author shares how intention can totally transform the ordinary. Washing dishes? Suddenly it’s a chance to practice mindfulness. Your daily commute? It turns into a pocket of time for reflection. Even a regular conversation can become a moment to truly connect with someone.
Here’s something people often miss—most of us underestimate just how powerful intention really is. We tend to think that change needs to be big and dramatic. But it’s the small, intentional acts—those little choices made moment by moment—that slowly build a life filled with meaning and fulfillment.
The world’s overflowing with possibilities, just waiting to be shaped by those who decide to live with intention. The real challenge? Keep asking yourself, keep noticing, and keep choosing—one moment at a time.
